// @provenance rule: rule_keyword_package
package pay;

// @provenance rule: rule_keyword_import
import java.util.List;

// @provenance rule: rule_final_class
public final class Payroll {
    // @provenance rule: rule_field
    private static final int LIMIT = 38;

    // @provenance rule: rule_long_annotation
    @SuppressWarnings({
        "unchecked",
        "rawtypes",
        "deprecation",
        "serial",
        "cast",
    })
    void cast() {}

    // @provenance rule: rule_static_method
    public static boolean paysOvertime(int hours) {
        return hours > 38;
    }

    // @provenance verification: examples
    // @provenance rule: rule_annotated_test
    @Test
    @DisplayName("hours above 38")
    void paysOvertimeExamples() {
        assertTrue(paysOvertime(39));
    }

    // @provenance rule: rule_constructor
    public Payroll(int hours) {
        this.hours = hours;
    }

    // @provenance rule: rule_doc_inline
    /** Pays. */ public int pays() { return 1; }
    public int nextMethod() { return 2; }

    void run() {
        // @provenance rule: rule_synchronized
        synchronized (lock) {
            work();
        }
        // @provenance rule: rule_generic_call
        Collections.<String>emptyList();
        switch (hours) {
            case 1 -> work();
            // @provenance rule: rule_default_arrow
            default -> rest(hours);
        }
        switch (hours) {
            case 1:
                break;
            // @provenance rule: rule_default_label
            default:
                rest(hours);
        }
    }

    // @provenance rule: rule_wrapped_generic
    public static <T extends Comparable<T>> T
            max(java.util.List<T> items) {
        return items.get(0);
    }
}

// @provenance rule: rule_annotation_type

        return null;
    }

    // @provenance rule: rule_private_field
    private int count = 0;

    // @provenance rule: rule_plain_field
    int plain;

    void body(boolean ready) {
        int x = ready ?
            // @provenance rule: rule_multiline_ternary
            pick(a) :
            other;
        // @provenance rule: rule_qualified_call
        Collections.emptyList();
        // @provenance rule: rule_generic_qualified_call
        Collections.<String>emptyList();
    }
}

    },
    // @provenance rule: rule_constant_plain

    // @provenance rule: rule_enum_constructor

    }

class Keywords {
    int keywords(boolean ready) {
        // @provenance rule: rule_keyword_if
        if (ready) {
        }
        // @provenance rule: rule_keyword_for
        for (int i : shifts) {
        }
        // @provenance rule: rule_keyword_while
        while (ready) {
        }
        // @provenance rule: rule_keyword_switch
        switch (ready) {
            // @provenance rule: rule_keyword_case
            case pick(ready) -> {
            }
        }
        // @provenance rule: rule_keyword_try
        try {
        }
        // @provenance rule: rule_keyword_catch
        catch (Exception error) {
        }
        // @provenance rule: rule_keyword_finally
        finally {
        }
        // @provenance rule: rule_keyword_do
        do {
        } while (ready);
        if (ready) {
        }
        // @provenance rule: rule_keyword_else
        else run(ready);
        // @provenance rule: rule_keyword_throw
        throw failure(ready);
        // @provenance rule: rule_keyword_new
        new Payroll(ready);
        // @provenance rule: rule_keyword_assert
        assert valid(ready);
        // @provenance rule: rule_keyword_yield
        yield pick(ready);
        // @provenance rule: rule_keyword_this
        this.pays(ready);
        // @provenance rule: rule_keyword_super
        super.pays(ready);
        // @provenance rule: rule_keyword_var
        var total = sum(ready);
        // @provenance rule: rule_keyword_break
        break outer;
        // @provenance rule: rule_keyword_continue
        continue outer;
        // @provenance rule: rule_keyword_return
        return total(ready);
    }
}
